title: A missing list opens a bare white 404 with no admin nav or way back
what_happens: Next's default "404 | This page could not be found." on plain white, outside the app's paper background, with no admin nav and no link back to Lists.
who_hurts: An admin opening an old link to a deleted list hits a dead end and has to edit the URL to get back.
suggested_fix: Add a small not-found.tsx under src/app/admin (or admin/lists/[id]) with "This list doesn't exist (it may have been deleted)" and a "← Lists" link, inside the admin layout.
